body: Transportation & Public Safety Commission Meeting Agendas
name: Regular meeting agenda
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF CANCELLATION OF MEETING

  TRANSPORTATION AND PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  December 24, 2025  7:00 P.M.

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regular meeting of the Transportation and Public Safety
Commission scheduled for January 14, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., in the Council Chamber, 5938 Kauffman
Avenue, is cancelled.

  The next regular meeting of the Transportation and Public Safety Commission is scheduled
for January 14, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber, 5938 Kauffman Avenue, Temple City.

Yansy Monroy
Secretary

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted on the
City of Temple City bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

Yansy Monroy, Secretary Signed and Posted December 19, 2025 (5:00 p.m.)
